svg.desc: At final phase-aligned operator error 1e-6, all twelve targets remain in each comparison. T includes T-dagger gates. Both panels use the same compiled circuits. Baselines are T-selected. Lizzy accepts shared frames only without increasing T or CX against its original T-only ladder winner. This is not a separate CX-optimized run. Against Qiskit formulas: Lizzy fewer T on 8, equal on 1, more on 0, no valid pair on 3; Against FlagSynth SDM*: Lizzy fewer T on 9, equal on 0, more on 0, no valid pair on 3; Against Qiskit QSD: Lizzy fewer T on 9, equal on 0, more on 0, no valid pair on 3; Against pytket: Lizzy fewer T on 5, equal on 2, more on 0, no valid pair on 5; Against BQSKit: Lizzy fewer T on 7, equal on 0, more on 0, no valid pair on 5; Against Qiskit formulas: Lizzy fewer CX on 5, equal on 2, more on 2, no valid pair on 3; Against FlagSynth SDM*: Lizzy fewer CX on 3, equal on 2, more on 4, no valid pair on 3; Against Qiskit QSD: Lizzy fewer CX on 3, equal on 2, more on 4, no valid pair on 3; Against pytket: Lizzy fewer CX on 1, equal on 2, more on 4, no valid pair on 5; Against BQSKit: Lizzy fewer CX on 0, equal on 2, more on 5, no valid pair on 5 Source: experiments/compiler_comparison_results.json. Regenerate: python docs/figures/generate.py.
svg.title: Compiler comparison, at a glance
